provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Nalvessir is centered at 23.839316, 110.776447 under Communalism, with 49,799,000 people across 8 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Nalvessir occupies 6,331,211.46 sq mi / 16,397,762.41 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.214832% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest and Beach and reefs with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Farming, Beach and reefs with water and Deep forest. Population density is 3.037 people/sq km / 7.866 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Tortle, Elf — Sea Elf, Genasi — Water Genasi, Harengon, Hadozee, Triton, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Black-Maw Myriad, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Bastveig, Thoryn-Rahek, Sigrananna, Iskareth, Hathruna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 7 recorded four-province geography group links, including 6 cross-transportation-group links. npcs.name: Jakk Cabot
npcs.description: Jakk Cabot is a Verdan noble scholar whose charm, wealth, and academic curiosity orbit one terrible family secret. He studies ancient relics, longevity rites, psychic artifacts, and ichor-serum stabilizers while insisting that imprisoning a dangerous patriarch is stewardship rather than fear. Jakk is urbane, generous, and evasive, especially when the truth would reveal how many lives his family's research has consumed.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Frostfen is a Village in Nalvessir, under Communalism, with moderate danger, Beach and reefs with water, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Verdan reads through the Verdan entry of the race compendium, within Orcs, Goblins, and Goblinoid Kin, marked by Enkirael. Fey-transformed humanoids who rapidly adapt physically and mentally as they age. They are resilient survivors with an unusually optimistic perspective on change. Table cues: +1 Constitution, +2 Charisma, Black Blood Healing, Limited Telepathy; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
rumors: Jakk has not aged correctly for a very long time, and neither have his household ledgers.
His kindest grants often go to scholars researching prisons, curses, or impossible lifespans.
plotHooks: Jakk hires the party to recover stolen serum before his imprisoned parent wakes hungry and coherent.
A rival scholar claims Jakk's family fortune comes from harvesting a captive mind, not protecting the public.

npcs.name: Pearl Softstep
npcs.description: Pearl Softstep is a courteous Autognome hotel investigator with immaculate manners, a detective’s patience, and a talent for making murder suspects underestimate the furniture. At the Frostfen Archive, she assists the Choral Synod by investigating hotel deaths, inheritance puzzles, missing guests, and suspiciously well-preserved secrets in old resort ledgers. Pearl is gentle, observant, and quietly relentless, especially when wealthy people assume a constructed investigator cannot understand grief, vanity, or motive.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Frostfen is a Village in Nalvessir, under Communalism, with moderate danger, Beach and reefs with water, Beach and grass with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Autognome reads through the Autognome entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Autognomes are mechanical or magically animated constructs resembling gnomes. They are often designed for specific purposes and may develop emergent personality traits over time. Table cues: Construct, Armored Casing, Built for Success, Healing Machine; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Pearl Softstep knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Pearl Softstep has a contact in Mythraelyn who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Pearl Softstep asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Pearl Softstep's public story is incomplete.
